title: Olive's Rainy Day Bush
note: b417 — Phase 5 continues (School readiness) — new alternative pronunciations ou as u, ear as er, or as er.

pages.brief: Olive the owl peering into a thick, leafy hedge, looking for a good spot.
Olive the owl carefully selecting dry twigs from among the hedge branches.
Olive the owl gathering a bundle of dry, crisp leaves.
Olive the owl arranging twigs and a leaf into a small, neat pile tucked into a gap in the hedge.
A sudden gust of wind blowing the twigs and leaves apart across the ground.
Olive the owl gathering up the scattered twigs and leaves once more, patient.
Olive the owl placing a flat stone on top of the rebuilt pile to weigh it down.
The pile of twigs and leaves holding firm under the flat stone, even as wind blows past.
Olive the owl settling comfortably into the finished, snug nook in the hedge.
Olive the owl resting contentedly in her hedge spot as rain begins to fall outside.
